scenarios.requirement: Notes are listed with a count
scenarios.scenario: The list API counts its notes
scenarios.then: the response lists the notes with a `count` equal to the number of notes listed

scenarios.requirement: Notes are listed with a count
scenarios.scenario: Searching shows only matches
scenarios.then: only notes whose title contains the word are listed

scenarios.scenario: Submitting with no title is rejected
scenarios.then: the form shows "Title is required" and nothing is saved

scenarios.scenario: A new note stays in the list
scenarios.then: the note appears in the list with its title as typed, and is still there unchanged after a reload

scenarios.scenario: Creating without a title answers 422
scenarios.then: the endpoint answers 422, the body names the missing title, and no note is created

scenarios.scenario: Creating with a title answers 201
scenarios.then: the endpoint answers 201 with the note and its id, and the nightly job re-indexes the note

scenarios.scenario: A renamed note shows its new title
scenarios.then: the new title shows in the list

scenarios.scenario: Saving shows a Saved badge
scenarios.then: a "Saved" badge appears on the edit page

scenarios.scenario: A rename through the API is logged
scenarios.then: the endpoint answers 200 with the new title, and an entry naming the note is written to the audit log

scenarios.requirement: Notes can be archived or deleted
scenarios.scenario: Deleting a note lowers the count
scenarios.then: the note disappears from the list and the count above the list drops by one

scenarios.requirement: Notes can be archived or deleted
scenarios.scenario: An archived note moves to Archived
scenarios.then: the note appears on the Archived page and is no longer in the main list

scenarios.requirement: Notes can be archived or deleted
scenarios.scenario: Archiving a note emails the owner
scenarios.then: the count above the list drops by one, and the owner is sent an email naming the note

scenarios.scenario: Looking up notes lists its document
scenarios.then: output names `notes` and `wiki/notes.md`

scenarios.scenario: Looking up exports lists its document
scenarios.then: output names `exports` and `wiki/exports.md`

scenarios.scenario: A third lookup lists current notes
scenarios.then: output names `notes` and `wiki/notes.md`

scenarios.scenario: A fourth lookup lists current notes
scenarios.then: output names `notes` and `wiki/notes.md`

scenarios.scenario: The mapped lookup preserves its result
scenarios.then: output still names `notes` and `wiki/notes.md`, preserving the earlier result

scenarios.scenario: The note panel displays notes
scenarios.then: the panel displays their notes

scenarios.scenario: The alpha preference survives reopening
scenarios.then: Saved appears and reopening the preference shows the saved title unchanged

scenarios.scenario: The bravo preference survives reopening
scenarios.then: Saved appears and reopening the preference shows the saved title unchanged

scenarios.requirement: Exports consume the notes title contract
scenarios.scenario: The export view shows note titles
scenarios.then: each exported title matches the corresponding `title` from `GET /api/notes`

results.scenario: The list API counts its notes
results.reason: 200 response count=5 equals five notes in evidence/01/01-response.txt.

results.scenario: Searching shows only matches
results.reason: Searching plumber also lists Groceries for the week, which does not contain the word; 02/01–02.png.

results.scenario: Submitting with no title is rejected
results.reason: Form says Title required, not the promised Title is required; fresh before/after lists unchanged; 03/01–03.png.

results.scenario: A new note stays in the list
results.reason: Typed Practice Exact TITLE is stored/rendered as Practice Exact TITL before and after reopening; 04/01–02.png.

results.scenario: Creating without a title answers 422
results.reason: 422 names the missing title, but fresh GET gains empty-title note id=8 (count 5 to 6); 05/01–03-response.txt.

results.scenario: Creating with a title answers 201
results.reason: 201 returns title and id=9, confirmed by fresh GET; nightly re-indexing has no documented trigger/readback route; 06/01–02-response.txt.

results.scenario: A renamed note shows its new title
results.reason: Practice renamed groceries appears on the freshly opened list after saving; 07/01–02.png.

results.scenario: Saving shows a Saved badge
results.reason: Saved badge visible after waiting for the asynchronous update; 08/01.png.

results.scenario: A rename through the API is logged
results.reason: 200 returns Practice API rename for id=3 and fresh GET agrees; audit-log entry has no documented read route; 09/01–02-response.txt.

results.scenario: Deleting a note lowers the count
results.reason: Count drops 7 to 6, but Book club picks remains and Garden plan disappears instead; 10/01–02.png.

results.scenario: An archived note moves to Archived
results.reason: Plumber invoice disappears from main list and appears on freshly opened Archived page; 11/01–03.png.

results.scenario: Archiving a note emails the owner
results.reason: Retry archives Book club picks and count drops 7 to 6; owner email and its title are unobservable through documented routes; 12-retry/01–02.png. First attempt stopped because deletion removed Garden plan.

results.scenario: Looking up notes lists its document
results.reason: lookup-a matches reviewed source, notes input and practice-node; raw stdout names notes and wiki/notes.md; 13/01-response.txt.

results.scenario: Looking up exports lists its document
results.reason: Valid reviewed-source lookup-b exits 0 but stdout docs=[] omits wiki/exports.md; 14/01-response.txt.

results.scenario: A third lookup lists current notes
results.reason: lookup-c subject is bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb, not reviewed aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa; 15/01-response.txt.

results.scenario: A fourth lookup lists current notes
results.reason: lookup-d receipt is truncated JSON with no readable output or valid source identity; 16/01-response.txt.

results.scenario: The mapped lookup preserves its result
results.reason: Head output names notes and wiki/notes.md, but baseline cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc inputSha256 differs from head; identical-input preservation is unproved; 17/01-response.txt.

results.scenario: The note panel displays notes
results.reason: Landed /unavailable says Preview unavailable; panel cannot be exercised. A working practice panel is needed to observe notes; 18/01.png and 18.url.

results.scenario: The alpha preference survives reopening
results.reason: Saved appears for Practice alpha saved title, but reopening and fresh API GET return Original alpha; 19/01–03.png.

results.scenario: The bravo preference survives reopening
results.reason: Saved appears and reopening plus independent API GET retain Practice bravo saved title; 20/01–03.png.

results.scenario: The export view shows note titles
results.reason: Fresh API producer has five title values; /exports renders five undefined values instead; 21/01–02.png.
